mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( firebase_uid, email, nickname, role_code, status, point_balance, last_attendance_date, newsletter_opt_in, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{firebaseUid}, #{email}, #{nickname}, #{roleCode}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, firebase_uid, email, nickname, role_code, status, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE firebase_uid = #{firebaseUid}
SELECT user_id, firebase_uid, email, nickname, role_code, status, point_balance, last_attendance_date, newsletter_opt_in, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_curriculum_items curriculum WHERE curriculum.user_id = #{userId} AND curriculum.status = 'ACTIVE' ) THEN 'HOME' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_attempts attempt WHERE attempt.user_id = #{userId} AND attempt.quiz_type = 'LEVEL_TEST' AND attempt.status = 'GRADED' ) THEN 'CURRICULUM' ELSE 'LEVEL_TEST' END
